I'm writing because several things have gone wrong at once and I'd like them handled together rather than across five separate tickets. First, our annual renewal went through last week, but we were charged at the old 60-seat price even though we reduced to 40 seats in March - I have the confirmation email from your sales rep, Priya, if you need it. Second, two of our new hires, Daniel and Mei, never received their invitation emails; I've checked their spam folders and resent the invites twice. Third, the export-to-Excel feature has been timing out for any report longer than about three months, which is a real problem because we are in the middle of quarter-end close. Fourth, our IT contractor asked me to confirm whether your platform supports single sign-on with Microsoft, because we'd like to set that up next month. Finally, I'd like a copy of your latest security certification for our compliance files. Please let me know who my point of contact will be for all of this. Thank you.
